keyEvents.text: Goal! Newcastle Jets 1, Macarthur 0. Xavier Bertoncello (Newcastle Jets) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Daniel Wilmering.
First Half ends, Newcastle Jets 1, Macarthur 0.
Substitution, Macarthur. Dylan Rose replaces Oliver Randazzo.
Substitution, Macarthur. Ryan Fraser replaces Connor Pain.
Second Half begins Newcastle Jets 1, Macarthur 0.
Zane Schreiber (Newcastle Jets) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Macarthur. Luke Vickery replaces Bernardo Oliveira.
Substitution, Newcastle Jets. Joe Shaughnessy replaces Alex Grant because of an injury.
Substitution, Newcastle Jets. Will Dobson replaces Julian Recchia.
Substitution, Macarthur. Ben Gibson replaces Dean Bosnjak.
Substitution, Newcastle Jets. Patrick Wood replaces Nikos Vergos.
Substitution, Newcastle Jets. Joe Lolley replaces Xavier Bertoncello.
Substitution, Macarthur. Musa Touré replaces Apostolos Stamatelopoulos.
Goal! Newcastle Jets 1, Macarthur 1. Musa Touré (Macarthur) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Ryan Fraser following a fast break.
Substitution, Newcastle Jets. Alex Badolato replaces Max Burgess.
Luke Vickery (Macarthur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Will Dobson (Newcastle Jets) is shown the yellow card.
